verified_checks.details: Full padded rfft output and normalized FFT frequency bins; complete STFT frames; Hann taper; power-of-two spectrogram guard; zero-hop coercion; one-sided bins; uncalibrated magnitude dB; Haar divisibility and finite nonnegative threshold guards agree with lessons. verified_checks.check: AUD004 correctly rejects its declared synthetic advantage claim
verified_checks.details: 2.313 - 0.034 = 2.279 ms, below the 5 ms timing threshold despite 51.021 dB separation exceeding 6 dB; all four fourth-partial bursts were detected. This remains a Python synthetic comparison, not guitar, IX binary, listening or WASM evidence.

2.8 - 1.0 = 1.8 dB; an error at most 1.8 dB around -3.9 dB gives decline interval [-5.7, -2.1] dB. Peak 0.98 fails the separate peak <0.95 guard. AUD002 deliberately states a distinct strict <1.8 dB illustrative gate; the two proposals are not a shared product standard.

verified_checks.check: Eight new translation source bindings and structural fidelity
verified_checks.details: Final translation SHA-256 and bound final English SHA-256 all match. Technical metadata (excluding localized course title), ordered external URLs and inline code match English exactly. Each new file has five exercise headings and five answer blocks. Every relative link resolves locally. Localized chronology note occurs exactly as declared.

Independently read all eight files. AUD002 preserves onset windows, -18.0 dB gain, predicted rather than measured gains and peaks, 2.8 dB residual, strict <1.8 dB illustrative gate and absent listening results. GAS002 preserves profile/setter order, readiness condition, coefficient arithmetic, 20.9 dB proposed ratio-error ceiling and separate guards, without inventing candidate results. AUD004 preserves calculated Morlet spans, distinct transforms, different denominators, 2.279 ms improvement failing 5 ms, passed 6 dB separation and synthetic Python rather than executable/guitar evidence. PHY002 preserves finite-DFT validity, 2205 samples/20 Hz, bin spacing versus resolving power, and approximate onset/pitch limits. No human approval was inferred.

The initially observed answer-key leakage was reported to root and fixed: prepare lesson copies with every inline answer block hidden/removed; withhold original answered lessons and rubric until response collection; use assisted-recall labeling if hiding is not guaranteed. Seven task/rubric pairs remain unexecuted and numerically accurate. Each rubric task has three criteria; all seven final English source hashes match current files. No learner pass or automatic course approval exists.
